_comment: Sample products for categories the founder's sample store doesn't carry yet (menswear, home furnishings). Invented for testing only; shaped like AnswerContext in src/ask/prompt.ts.

product.title: Oxford Cloth Button-Down
product.description: A classic button-down in 100% cotton oxford cloth with a soft-rolled collar, one chest pocket and a box pleat at the back. Price: $98.00

answers.question: Can I return it?
answers.answer: Unworn, unwashed items with tags can be returned within 30 days for a refund or exchange.

answers.question: Do you do alterations?
answers.answer: We offer free sleeve shortening on full-price shirts; it takes about a week.

greatWhen: you want one shirt that works with jeans or a blazer
you like a shirt that gets softer every wash
enrichment.fitNotes: Classic fit through the chest and waist; true to size. Size down for a closer fit.
enrichment.care: Machine wash cold, hang to dry. Warm iron if you want it crisp.

faq.question: Does it shrink?
faq.answer: Up to about 2% after the first hot wash; wash cold to avoid it.

training.whoItsFor: Anyone who wants a smart-casual shirt that also works under a blazer.
training.whoItsNotFor: Someone who wants a very slim, formal dress shirt.
training.closestAlternative: Our poplin dress shirt is smoother and more formal.

facts.fact: Button-down collar with a box pleat at the back

reviews.text: Fits true to size and got softer after a few washes.

product.title: Washed Linen Duvet Cover
product.description: Stonewashed 100% linen duvet cover with a hidden button closure and corner ties. Price: $289.00 (Queen)

answers.question: Can I return bedding once opened?
answers.answer: Bedding can be returned within 30 days if it's unwashed and in its original packaging.

greatWhen: you like a relaxed, lived-in look
you want bedding that gets softer with time
enrichment.materials: 100% European flax linen, stonewashed for softness.
enrichment.fitNotes: Twin 68x90 in, Queen 90x90 in, King 106x90 in.
enrichment.care: Machine wash warm, tumble dry low. No bleach. No ironing needed — the texture is part of the look.

facts.fact: Hidden button closure with interior corner ties

reviews.text: A little rough at first, soft after two washes.
